system.description:
VESPERYN

The scent of living blood reaches you with impossible clarity, carrying information that ordinary senses could never perceive.
You gain Blood Sense as a tertiary sense with a range of 30 feet.
Blood Sense You can detect the presence and general direction of living creatures within range that are currently suffering from a Bleed effect or have been reduced to half their maximum HP or fewer. Blood Sense does not reveal a creature's exact location, identity, current HP or the nature of its injuries.
Furthermore, you gain a +2 racial bonus to Track (Survival) checks when following a trail containing fresh blood.

Prerequisites Level 5

Works automatically: Blood Sense (30 ft, tertiary) is on your senses list; +2 racial to Track is offered with the book's wording.

sense.name: Blood Sense
sense.finds: living creatures suffering a Bleed effect or at half their maximum HP or fewer

conditionals.label: Blood-Scent
conditionals.scope: Track checks following a trail containing fresh blood
